## 中文原文
周末早上，你打算在家打扫客厅。先拿起吸尘器准备吸地板，结果吸尘器启动不了。你检查了插头，发现电源线松了，插紧之后机器就能正常工作了。

## My translation
On the weekend morning, I decided to clean the dinning room.
I was about to use the vacuum to clean the floor, but it didn't work.
Then I checked the plug and found the cable was not at the right place.
So I plugged in again, then the machine worked properly.

## Revised version
One weekend morning, I decided to clean the dining room.
I was about to vacuum the floor, the the vacuum wouldn't turn on.
I checked the plug and saw the power cord was loose.
Once I pluged it back in, the machine worked fine.

## Key phrases
- one weekend morning，某一个周末早上。或者 on Saturday/Sunday morning
- vacuum the floor，固定搭配，吸尘器吸地板
- turn on，电器
- power cord was loose，电源线松了
- pluged it back in，动词短语要加宾语
